name: Page layout and page header
summary: The frame of a product screen: page background, padding and spacing, and the header with the page title and its main actions.
useWhen: Every full screen in a product (lists, forms, settings).
A screen needs a title and one main action such as "New entry".

dontUseWhen.case: Content inside a modal or side panel
dontUseWhen.use: the modal or side panel header

dontUseWhen.case: A small section inside a page

anatomy.description: The page frame: light grey background, padding, vertical gap between its children. White surfaces (table, cards) sit on it. Use <main> when the page is the whole app; use <div> inside an app shell that already has a <main>. The shell can remove the frame padding with --page-padding: 0 (and --page-padding-mobile: 0).
Title on the left, actions on the right. Wraps on narrow screens.
The page title. One <h1> per page. 24px semibold.
Optional short description or count, e.g. "124 entries".
Buttons for the page. At most one primary, plus up to two others; put more in a menu.
Groups related blocks with a smaller gap, e.g. bulk bar + table + pagination.

modifiers.description: Centres the page at 640px max. Use for forms and settings.

a11y: Exactly one <main> per document: gds-page is the <main>, unless an app shell already provides one (then gds-page is a <div> inside it). Exactly one <h1> (the page title).
If a section has no visible heading, give it aria-label.

rules.rule: A page has exactly one gds-page-header__title and it is an <h1>.
rules.why: Screen reader users jump to the h1 to know where they are.

rules.rule: gds-page-header__actions contains at most one gds-btn--primary.
rules.why: One clear main action per screen.

rules.rule: Use gds-page, gds-page-header and gds-filter-bar for page layout instead of product CSS.
rules.why: These were the most common custom CSS in AI tests; they now exist in GDS.

rules.rule: Forms and settings pages use gds-page--narrow; lists and tables use the full width.
rules.why: Long lines of form fields are hard to scan; tables need the width.

knownIssues.issue: No docs page yet; only this contract and the AI guide describe it.
knownIssues.fix: Add a Page patterns page to the docs site.

knownIssues.issue: gds-page uses min-height: 100%, so the grey background only fills the viewport when html and body have height: 100% (or the app shell gives the page a height).
knownIssues.fix: Document html, body { height: 100% } in Setup, or use min-height: 100dvh when the page is the whole viewport.

knownIssues.issue: Inside an app shell that has its own padding, gds-page adds its padding on top.
knownIssues.fix: Set --page-padding: 0 and --page-padding-mobile: 0 on the shell or on the page. Reported in the first product pilot (Nov 2026).
